_what: The stops after Durgapur (or, for a train that does not stop at Durgapur, after Asansol) of the trains that share a name with another train and go a different way, as RailRadar's timetable gave them (the app's own fare-leg tables, read 21 Nov 2026): the distance in km from that station follows the @. They are the evidence for routeVia.ts, which names each train's route by one station that the other trains of its name do not call at. 12303 is also 'Poorva Express (via Patna)' on Wikipedia, with a halt at Patna Jn on ixigo and etrain.
